name: Buck
flavour: Slow to start. Impossible to stop.
art_prompt: a lanky anthropomorphic deer man with tan fur, a long muzzle, big calm eyes, tall branching antlers on his head, wearing a plain teal t-shirt and khaki shorts with sneakers, standing straight with hands relaxed at the sides
motion: running in place at a long-legged bounding jog, arms and legs pumping, antlers steady
anim_hint: a lanky deer man with tan fur and tall branching antlers, in a teal t-shirt and khaki shorts, long bounding strides with the knees lifting high and the arms pumping
anim_negative: human face, missing antlers, extra limbs
portrait_prompt: leaning in with a slow easy grin and one eyebrow raised, his antlers filling the top of the frame, a thumb hooked in the collar of his teal t-shirt
hurt_hint: antlers intact, ears pinned back, teeth gritted
trait_text: Starts 15% slower. While he is not hit, his speed climbs to +60% and his might to +50% over 12 s; one hit resets it. Dust and streaks behind him show the charge.
back_hint: He faces away from the viewer: only the back of his head, the back of his antlers and ears, the back of the t-shirt and the heels are visible, no eyes, no muzzle, no face at all. Both arms hang straight down along his sides, relaxed.
